title: 第1530章 死而复生第1529章 太白称绝
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
庄园中。
有人眼睛流淌出鲜血，也有人大脑一痛感觉神魂要被切割开来了。
还有人当场吐出了鲜血。
他们都不知道发生了什么事，只感觉有一道光闪过，便被直接重创。
很多人都惊骇的看着太白子，刚才是发生了什么？
刚才太白子出剑了，可是又不像！
“好纯粹的剑意！”
洛熙神剑士目光猛然看着太白子，又看向角落中的那个青年。
只有他们这样的剑客才知晓刚才发生了什么。
刚才这两人，以剑意隔空斩了一剑，这是纯粹剑道上的比拼。
“这是何人？”
有人开口也已经注意到了角落的那个青年。
“有意思，上次还没问过你名字，你叫什么？”
太白子再度睁开眼眸，他目光看着角落的那个青年。
“聂科！”
角落中那个青年起身看着太白子平静的说道，聂科眼神平静，可在这种平静之下，却有生气与死气的快速转变。
太白子看着聂科，脑海中出现了几年前的画面。
那时他刚刚出世不久，听说他们太白神庭疆域中来了一位剑客，于是见猎欣喜，想要顺道检验一下当世剑客的水准，便主动找了过去。
这个人正是聂科。
而聂科也没有让他失望，竟然能够接住他一剑。

而之后太白子更是用了十剑才斩杀聂科，这让太白子也出乎意料。
从心里对聂科很认可。
但太白子很确定，聂科已经死了，在他的剑光下不可能还活着。
可现如今聂科确实还活着，并且站在他的面前。
更关键的是，聂科变得更强大了，那剑意，已经可以威胁到他。
这让太白子觉得很有意思。
“涅槃新生，并且是让剑意也一同涅槃新生，这种剑法倒是有趣！”
太白子轻声说道，经过上次接触以及刚才这一剑，太白子已经看出了聂科的一些底细。
“不愧是曾经的剑圣！”
本土阵营中，有人轻声说道。
聂科消失了很久，在灵气复苏时代，也并没有太过惊人的战绩，特别是在域外天骄降临后，所以很多人都认为聂科已经掉队，可如今看来，聂科分明没有掉队，反而比之前更加强大了。
“这位太白子恐怕也是一位古代怪胎，就是不知道是不是不败主？聂科竟然能与他交手，难道聂科的实力已经接近超一流战力了？”
有人低声说道，超一流战力是人们用来对应那些不败主以及一些特殊的古代怪胎的。
而大夏本土阵营中，目前算是超一流战力的，明面上只有夏皇，世尊，天尊以及魔尊，许天农，阴阳子。
如今看来聂科也距离超一流战力不远了。
“当世之人，你的剑道天赋或许可排进前三，上次没能彻底斩杀你，这一次就彻底断绝你的生机吧。”
太白子平静的说道。
聂科没有说话，只是用行动表明了自己的态度，他握着手中之剑，下一刻，宝剑出鞘。
庄园之中。
剑光纵横，很多剑客在这一刻感受到一股难以言说的压迫，这是聂科的剑道对他们的剑道的冲击。
content_en:
In the manor.
Some people had blood flowing from their eyes, and some felt a pain in their brains as if their souls were about to be cut apart.
Some people vomited blood on the spot.
They didn't know what happened. They just felt a flash of light and were hit hard.
Many people looked at Taibaizi in horror, what happened just now?
Just now Taibaizi drew his sword, but it didn't look like it!
"What pure sword intent!"
Divine Swordsman Luo Xi looked at Taibaizi suddenly, and then at the young man in the corner.
Only swordsmen like them know what just happened.
Just now, the two of them slashed through the air with their sword intent. This was a pure competition in swordsmanship.
"Who is this?"
Someone spoke and already noticed the young man in the corner.
"Interesting, I didn't ask you your name last time. What is your name?"
Taibaizi opened his eyes again and looked at the young man in the corner.
"Nie Ke!"
The young man in the corner stood up and looked at Taibaizi and said calmly. Nie Ke's eyes were calm, but under this calmness, there was a rapid change between life and death.
Taibaizi looked at Nie Ke, and the scene from a few years ago appeared in his mind.
Not long after he was born at that time, he heard that a swordsman had come to their Taibai Divine Court territory, so he was delighted to see Lie and wanted to test the level of the current swordsman, so he took the initiative to find him.
This person is Nie Ke.
And Nie Ke did not disappoint him, and was actually able to catch his sword.
Later, Taibaizi used ten swords to kill Nie Ke, which surprised Taibaizi.
I approve of Nie Ke from the bottom of my heart.
But Taibaizi was very sure that Nie Ke was dead and could not still be alive under the light of his sword.
But now Nie Ke is indeed still alive and standing in front of him.
What's more important is that Nie Ke has become stronger, and the sword intention can already threaten him.
This made Taibaizi very interesting.
"Nirvana is reborn, and the sword intention is also reborn in Nirvana. This kind of swordsmanship is quite interesting!"
Taibaizi said softly that after the last contact and the sword just now, Taibaizi had already seen some details about Nie Ke.
"As expected of the former Sword Master!"
Someone in the local camp said softly.
Nie Ke disappeared for a long time, and in the era of spiritual energy recovery, he did not have any amazing results, especially after the arrival of the genius from outside the territory, so many people thought that Nie Ke had fallen behind. But now it seems that Nie Ke has clearly not fallen behind, but is even stronger than before.
"I'm afraid this Taibaizi is also an ancient freak, but I don't know if he is the undefeated master? Nie Ke can actually fight with him. Is Nie Ke's strength close to super-class combat power?"
Someone whispered that super-class combat power was used by people to deal with those undefeated lords and some special ancient freaks.
As for Daxia's local camp, the only ones with superior combat power are Xia Emperor, World Honored One, Tianzun and Demon Lord, Xu Tiannong and Yin Yangzi.
Now it seems that Nie Ke is not far away from super-class combat power.
"In this world, your swordsmanship talent may be ranked among the top three. I couldn't kill you completely last time, so I will completely cut off your life this time."
Taibaizi said calmly.
Nie Ke did not speak, but expressed his attitude with actions. He held the sword in his hand, and the next moment, the sword was unsheathed.
In the manor.
The sword light was everywhere, and many swordsmen felt an unspeakable oppression at this moment. This was the impact of Nie Ke's swordsmanship on their swordsmanship.
